Name: Registration Points
Description: The Registration Points Version B (REGPTB) TRE contains registration points that may be provided for image or map data to identify specific pixels in this data and provide spatial locations (geographic or cartographic) for these pixels.

NUM_PTS.Name: Number of Registration Points
NUM_PTS.Description: This field shall contain the number of registration points to follow.

PID<NUM_PTS>.Name: nth Registration Point ID
PID<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain a unique identifier of the nth registration point.

LON<NUM_PTS>.Name: Longitude/Easting of the nth Registration Point
LON<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or longitude (otherwise) of the nth registration point in the absolute coordinate system.

LAT<NUM_PTS>.Name: Latitude/Northing of the nth Registration Point
LAT<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or latitude (otherwise) of the nth registration point in the absolute coordinate system.

ZVL<NUM_PTS>.Name: Elevation of nth Registration Point
ZVL<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field can contain the elevation of the registration point in the absolute coordinate system if the vertical reference is defined (see GEOPS.VDCDVR). The default value is all BCS spaces.

DIX<NUM_PTS>.Name: Column Number of nth Registration Point
DIX<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain the column number of the corresponding pixel.

DIY<NUM_PTS>.Name: Row Number of nth Registration Point
DIY<NUM_PTS>.Description: This field shall contain the row number of the corresponding pixel.
